name: New Creation In Christ
overview: The concept of being a new creation in Christ centers on God’s transformative work in believers, replacing their old, sinful nature with a renewed heart and spirit, as Ezekiel promises a new heart and spirit within His people. Scripture calls believers to forsake their former ways, putting off the corrupt 'old man' and not dwelling on past sins or former lives, as Isaiah and Ephesians instruct. Through faith in Christ’s sacrificial love, believers are united with Him, living by His life rather than their own, and are created anew for good works ordained by God, emphasizing both spiritual renewal and purposeful living.
